items.title: Nvidia Stock Shock Has Investors Rethinking AI Infrastructure ETFs
items.summary: Governance risk at Nvidia has suddenly moved from fine print to front page, and that shift matters for every investor leaning on big tech ETFs for stability. When a single leadership probe can ripple through AI supply chains and export rules, concentration risk stops being theoretical.
